verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway explicitly documents LLM provider routing (multi-LLM support across OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.), MCP traffic governance/security/observability, rate limiting plugins, data governance/DLP and prompt/safety guards, and OTel metrics for AI/MCP/A2A traffic — directly matching the story's token limits, prompt guards, and provider routing asks. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of these AI-gateway/MCP governance features (most evidence is vendor docs), and no concrete production benchmark of prompt-guard or token-limit enforcement at scale.
